criteria.text: User Action: Clicks “Join with a code” on the “Your household” screen. Expected System Behavior: The “Join a household” screen opens with one field, Invite code.
The Invite code field ignores letter case and leading or trailing spaces.
User Action: Enters a valid code and clicks “Join.” Expected System Behavior: The user is added to the household, the Chore List opens, and a message shows: “You joined [Household name].”
criteria.note: Not met yet: joining and opening the Chore List work, but the “You joined…” message isn't built until a message design exists (README “Conflicts to resolve”, row 9).

criteria.text: User Action: Clicks “Back.” Expected System Behavior: Returns to the “Your household” screen.
Error Condition: Invite code is empty. Message: “Enter an invite code.”
Error Condition: Code does not match any household. Message: “We couldn’t find a household with that code. Check with your housemate and try again.”
Error Condition: Server error. Message: “Something went wrong. Please try again.”
